_comment: ThreePlayerTicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is.

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, one of A, B or C
_slots.{row}: The board row index of the placed mark
_slots.{col}: The board column index of the placed mark
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII board (do not translate)
_slots.{moves}: The comma-separated list of available move tokens like '[4]' (do not translate)

player_prompt.intro: Ị bụ onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} na atọ-Player Tic Tac Toe. Ihe akara gị bụ '{symbol}'. Ị na-agbanwe agbanwe na-etinye akara gị na bọọdụ 5x5 iji mepụta ahịrị anọ. Ahịrị nwere ike ịdị na-agbanwe agbanwe, kwụ ọtọ, ma ọ bụ diagonal. Nyefee usoro gị site na iji usoro '[4] 'iji akara cell 4.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ụdị mbugharị na-abaghị uru. Jiri "[cell]" ebe cell bụ 0-{max_cell}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Nọmba cell na-abaghị uru: {cell}. Ọ ga-adị n'etiti 0 na {max_cell}.
invalid_move.made_invalid: Onye ọkpụkpọ {player_id} mere ngagharị na-abaghị uru

game_action.placed: Onye na-egwu egwu {player_id} na-etinye akara ngosi ha ({symbol}) n'ọhịa ({row}, {col}).
